final:
longest(take a: List[int], take b: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() >= a.len() and out.len() >= b.len()
  ex longest([1, 2], [3]) == [1, 2]
  ex longest([1], [2]) == [1]
  if b.len() > a.len()
    b
  else
    a

test_longest() =
  assert longest([1, 2, 3], [4, 5]) == [1, 2, 3]
  assert longest([1], [2, 3]) == [2, 3]
  assert longest([1, 2], [3, 4]) == [1, 2]
